assignee.description: Department manager id, or worker id once spawned.

worker_role.description: Role template used to spawn the worker.

path_trace.description: Ordered chain of agent/ticket ids this ticket came through.

context.description: Only what the assignee needs. Prefer pointers to workspace files over pasted content.

format.description: e.g. summary, file, dataset, patch, yes/no with evidence.

destination.description: Workspace path for artifacts, if any.

rigor.description: How good is good enough. Set by the director's rigor profile; used by workers and Verification.

questions.description: Clarification requests going upward and their answers.

result.description: Filled on completion, shaped by return_spec.

code.description: Marks a code ticket: the worker edits an isolated git worktree under these limits.

acceptance.description: Shell commands that must all exit 0 in the worktree.

context_files.description: Files shown to the worker up front.

models.description: Model choice for this ticket and everything below it (set by the level above, e.g. a stronger model for a hard ticket). Missing tiers use the config.

manager.description: Model for the manager deciding this ticket.

worker.description: First model for workers under this ticket; the config's fallback chain follows.

worker_tickets.description: Precise worker tickets the manager must delegate as written, skipping its own planning.

escalation.description: Present while the ticket is escalated or waiting on a question: who must handle it.
